name: Geo Targetly Geo Location
author: geotargetly

sections.description:
Retrieve a visitor’s precise country, state, region, city, latitude-longitude, and IP address the moment they land on your WordPress site, without displaying any permission prompt.

Use this data to automatically centre maps, display “Hey !” copy, pre-select form fields, run location-specific pop-ups, or trigger any custom JavaScript.

Drop a single JavaScript snippet into your header and start calling ready-made JS variables or HTML geo-tags. Perfect for both simple personalisation jobs and heavy-duty multi-regional builds.

Behind the scenes, you get enterprise-grade IP accuracy (IPv4 + IPv6), a global edge network, and built-in analytics to keep tabs on every lookup.

This plugin is made by Geo Targetly.

  • Paid account is required – see pricing
  • 14-day free trial – no credit card needed

Features

  • Detect visitor country, state, region, city, latitude, longitude & IP address
  • Access data via simple JavaScript variables or geo-HTML tags
  • Display location data inside any sentence, banner or popup
  • Autofill inputs & dropdowns with visitor location and currency/calling codes
  • Auto-centre maps and “nearest-store” lists using lat-long
  • Non-intrusive IP detection, no browser prompt required
  • Enterprise accuracy (≈ 99 % country, 80-90 % state, 70-80 % city)
  • IPv6 supported, future-proof lookups
  • No local database to maintain, lightweight JS call to Geo Targetly cloud
  • Built-in analytics & test mode to simulate any location

Detailed docs can be found below

  • Overview https://geotargetly.com/ip-geolocation-api
  • Quick Start Guide https://help.geotargetly.com/en/articles/2149369-geo-location-quick-start-guide
  • Docs https://help.geotargetly.com/en/collections/738541-geo-location

Support

  • Live chat at Geo Targetly

External services

This plugin connects to an external endpoint via the domain https://g792337341.co to load and run a script that powers its core functionality, as outlined previously in the description.

It sends the user’s location each time the plugin is loaded. This is necessary to determine and customize the plugin’s behavior based on the user’s geographical context.

Additionally, this plugin connects to analytics endpoint https://g97676560.co/ to track plugin installation and usage over time.

This service is provided by Geo Targetly – Terms of Use, Privacy Policy.
